parts.text: (a) (i) A rectangular glass tank contains 3.0 m 3 of liquid. The mass of the liquid is 2800 kg. Calculate the density of the liquid. density = ......................................................... [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) A metal block is placed in the tank and it sinks to the bottom. The top surface of the block is 1.1 m below the surface of the liquid. Fig. 4.1 shows the block on the bottom of the tank. Fig. 4.1 Calculate the force exerted by the liquid on the top of the block. force on top of the block = ......................................................... [4]
